localSourceScope: Current candidate dist files are runner context only. Frozen baseline identity and stability are determined exclusively by the complete actual served-source audits.

servedIdentityBefore.scope: All served JS/HTML/CSS bytes match the declared build; each stored irradiance volume matches its manifest. Media beyond these declared fields retain their separate artifact identities. This proves byte identity, not rendered validity.

servedIdentityAfter.scope: All served JS/HTML/CSS bytes match the declared build; each stored irradiance volume matches its manifest. Media beyond these declared fields retain their separate artifact identities. This proves byte identity, not rendered validity.

cases.scope: Trusted browser input through Playwright keyboard. Actual received event times and production solver trace are retained; this is not physical keyboard rollover.

trace.policy: 120 Hz during the 20 s window after E/Q/1/2; other keyboard events remain recorded. A rolling journal, not an entire long-drive archive.
trace.scope: Only retained production samples are summarized. Trace expiry, rolling eviction and screenshot delays can leave uncovered intervals; zero recorded contacts is not a whole-trial no-contact certificate.

cases.pitchTravelDatum: Cumulative actual body-axis quaternion travel since the most recent scenario reset; not Euler pitch and not reset again for the airborne subtrial.
